value.rationale: An intrinsically motivated exact facet classification for the classical wheel family gives the lower GP parameter, all irredundant size counts via a rational two-state transfer, the unique pure cases and arbitrarily long gaps in the maximal-size spectrum. These are structurally distinct from the established optimum or all-feasible-set enumerators.
